title: Urology in the Vietnam War, chapter 1 (AMEDD official history)
citation: James N. Wettlaufer and John W. Weigel, eds., Urology in the Vietnam War: Casualty Management and Lessons Learned (Washington, D.C.: Borden Institute, Office of The Surgeon General), chapter 1.
notes: Official Army Medical Department history. Dates the Japan hospital buildup: 7th Field Hospital arrived November 1965 (Johnson AFB); 249th General Hospital operational at Camp Drake December 1965; 106th General Hospital operational at Kishine Barracks December 1965; the Camp Zama hospital (U.S. Army Medical Center, Japan, established 1958, ~100 beds in 1965) was the receiving hospital before then. Also documents the 1965 evacuation route via Clark AB, Philippines.
